question: Which of the following combinations is NOT correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ammonotelic – cartilaginous fish**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Nitrogenous waste can be divided into three groups based on its toxicity.

__
 
• Ammonia – animals secreting **ammonia** are called **Ammonotelic**.
 
• Urea - animals secreting **urea** are called **Ureotelic**.
 
• Uric acid - animals secreting **uric acid** are called **Uricotelic**.
 
• ​​Aquatic animals are essentially ammonotelic.
 
• Fishes have an aquatic habitat suitable for excreting ammonia, as it requires plenty of water for its elimination.
 
• **Humans** and **cartilaginous fishes** are ureotelic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Birds & reptiles secrete Uric acid as their main excretory product because Uric acid is a very less toxic waste and it does not require a lot of water for its elimination.
 
• Uric acid is excreted in the form of a semiliquid paste.
 
• Mammals are ureotelic in nature i.e., they excrete urea as their primary excretory substance.
 
• Urea is moderately water-soluble nitrogenous waste that does not require a lot of water for its elimination and can easily be excreted by mammals.
